description: Deprecated SQL facade for selecting, inserting, updating, and deleting data in automatically detected spreadsheet tables, including limited WITH queries; discovery reads at most 10,000 rows per sheet. For detected header-based tables, the first data row is skipped and update/delete row targeting can be offset.

sql.title: Sql
examples: WITH ActiveUsers AS (SELECT * FROM "Users" WHERE status = 'active') SELECT name, email FROM ActiveUsers
UPDATE "Inventory" SET quantity = quantity - 10 WHERE sku = 'ABC123'
sql.description: Complete SQL query to execute. Must begin with SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, or WITH. Supports Common Table Expressions (CTEs) using WITH clause for complex queries. Note: WITH clauses require the sqlglot library for full support; simple SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE operations work without it. Use table names (sheet names) in FROM/INTO clauses, not A1 range notation. The query must include proper SQL clauses (e.g., SELECT columns FROM table, not just a column name or condition). Example: SELECT * FROM "Sheet1" WHERE A = 'value' (correct) instead of just A = 'value' (incorrect).
sql.human_parameter_description: Enter the SQL command you wish to execute on the spreadsheet. This allows you to manipulate data directly using familiar SQL syntax.

dry_run.title: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Preview changes without applying them (for write operations)
dry_run.human_parameter_description: Select this option if you want to see what changes would be made without actually applying them. It's a safe way to check before executing.

delete_method.title: Delete Method
delete_method.description: For DELETE operations: 'clear' preserves row structure, 'remove_rows' shifts data up
delete_method.human_parameter_description: Choose how you want to delete data. 'Clear' removes the content but keeps the structure, while 'remove_rows' deletes rows and shifts the remaining data up.

spreadsheet_id.title: Spreadsheet Id
spreadsheet_id.description: The unique alphanumeric ID of the Google Spreadsheet extracted from the URL. Format: A long string of letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores (typically 44 characters). Find it in the URL: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/{SPREADSHEET_ID}/edit. Must be a valid ID - values like 'auto' are NOT valid and will fail.
spreadsheet_id.human_parameter_description: Provide the unique ID of the Google Spreadsheet you want to work with. This is NOT 'auto' or any placeholder - it must be the actual ID from the spreadsheet URL. Example URL: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms/edit - the ID is '1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms'.

type.title: Type
type.description: Column data type as reported by the engine (e.g., 'TEXT', 'INTEGER').

data.title: Data
data.description: Array of data returned by the executed SQL query. For SELECT, each item is an object representing a row; empty when no rows are returned or for non-SELECT operations.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error message if an error occurred during execution. Present when successful is false; absent otherwise.

message.title: Message
message.description: Human-readable status message describing the result of the operation (e.g., 'Retrieved 21 rows').

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: The SQL operation type executed (e.g., SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE).

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Indicates whether the operation completed successfully.

display_url.title: Display Url
display_url.description: URL to view the spreadsheet in Google Sheets web interface.

table_schema.title: Table Schema
table_schema.description: Array containing table schema information relevant to the operation. For SELECT, describes result set columns; empty array if no columns are returned or for non-SELECT operations.

affected_rows.title: Affected Rows
affected_rows.description: Number of rows affected by the executed SQL operation. For SELECT operations, this equals the number of rows retrieved; for INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, it equals the number of rows inserted/updated/deleted.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not
